name: mac-local-node
role: Cheap local worker + typed decider. Never the executive brain, never a self-reviewer. Final review stays with a GPT/Codex-class model.

ollama.note: Run as a sidecar on its own port so an older installed Ollama app is never modified.

worker.notes: Always emits a <think> block (think:false did not suppress it on Ollama 0.33/0.40 as tested). Budget >=1500 output tokens or content comes back empty. Quality is NOT yet evaluated; speed and tool-call correctness only.

decider.notes: Zero generated tokens; returns probabilities. Advisory only: deterministic policy code stays authoritative for approval gates. Use tev1:4b (4.4 GB) if accuracy matters more than memory.

guard.note: Swap is judged by GROWTH since start, not absolute use: macOS keeps old swap allocated after pressure subsides.

boundaries: No outreach, submissions, spending, publishing or production changes without explicit human approval.
No secrets, tokens or private data in this folder or in prompts logged to Git.
Local output is a draft or a hypothesis until independently reviewed.
Do not replace deterministic validation or approval gates with decider output.
Server binds to LAN (0.0.0.0) for authorized node-to-node communication; keep on private trusted LAN.
